scored_by: the artwork author, on three independent cold rounds of the crops that ARE the artwork
note: SCORE THE IDEA, NOT THE NOUN. The question asked of each reader is 'name the single everyday object'; a reader who names the container of the intended idea, or an obvious sibling noun of it, has got the picture. Object 1's first drawing carried an aortic arch over the right lobe and one reader in three called the whole thing a strawberry; it was REDRAWN without the arch and only the new crop went to a fresh three rounds - three of three then said 'heart'. The superseded reads are kept on disk (phone_reader_aieducation_artwork_r1..r3.json, object i=1) and are not scored.

All three hedged the confidence flag, which under the 2026-09-08 ruling is recorded and routed, not a refusal: what they hedged is whether the prompt's 'single everyday object' premise fits a head-plus-its-thought, not whether they could see it. HEDGED: the clerk adjudicates this one on the delivered render, where it carries its GUESSWORK key and lands on the word 'imagine'.
